items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Oh, there used to be a good tenor player around there named Raymond(?) Valentine.

ctx.x: No, '25 or '26. Not too little. What I remember about New York then was that... I don't know, you could put your nickel in and get the food out. I thought that was magic, you know.

When I came out here... Let me see... I did a lot of shit before that time. Seems that I stayed around Minneapolis for a little while. Oh, there used to be a good tenor player around there named Raymond(?) Valentine. You ever hear of him?
